<details>
<summary>📝 Walkthrough</summary>

## Walkthrough

Makefile adds PYYAML_VER (6.0.3), PYYAML_DIST_DIR (pyyaml_dist), and PYYAML_STAMP plus a stamp target that installs `pyyaml==$(PYYAML_VER)` into `$(TOOLS_BIN_DIR)/$(PYYAML_DIST_DIR)` using `python3 -m pip install --target=...` and touches the stamp. `verify-docs-nav` now depends on that stamp and runs `hack/verify-docs-nav-order.py` with `PYTHONPATH` pointing at the installed pyyaml location. Tooling install recipes for `codespell` and `gitlint` were changed to invoke `python3 -m pip install --target=...` instead of `pip`.

## Sequence Diagram(s)

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    actor Makefile
    participant Pip as "python3 -m pip"
    participant FS as "Tools Dir ($(TOOLS_BIN_DIR)/pyyaml_dist)"
    participant Script as "hack/verify-docs-nav-order.py"

    Makefile->>Pip: install pyyaml==6.0.3 --target=$(TOOLS_BIN_DIR)/pyyaml_dist
    Pip-->>FS: write pyyaml files into $(TOOLS_BIN_DIR)/pyyaml_dist
    Pip-->>FS: create stamp file $(PYYAML_STAMP)
    Makefile->>Script: set PYTHONPATH=$(TOOLS_BIN_DIR)/pyyaml_dist\nrun verify-docs-nav-order.py
    Script->>FS: import pyyaml from $(TOOLS_BIN_DIR)/pyyaml_dist
    Script-->>Makefile: exit (verify completed)
```

</details>

>- [ ] Run `make verify` end-to-end — all Python steps should pass without pre-sourcing a venv
>- [ ] Subsequent runs reuse the existing venv (no reinstall)
>
